name: comp-168
title: NPS Score Radio Scale
description: Eleven joined cells from 0 to 10 under the question How likely are you to recommend us?, with an angry face and Not likely at one end and Very likely with a heart-eyes face at the other. Clicking a cell keeps it lit white.
use: Running a one-question recommendation survey where the familiar 0 to 10 score is expected.
avoid: Eleven cells need horizontal room, so on a narrow phone the outer boxes crowd their digits.
a11y: Radios take arrow keys and show a focus ring, and the legend frames the question, but each option is named only by its digit. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white question sits above an unbroken row of eleven square cells numbered 0 to 10, each with a thin grey border and the outer ends rounded, on black. A small angry face and Not likely sit under the left end, Very likely and a grinning face under the right.
behaves: Nothing is chosen at first. Hovering a cell tints it grey, and clicking fills it white with dark digits; the recording steps from 6 to 9 to 10.
customise: The 0 to 10 values, the question and the two end labels are written in the file; shorten the array to change the range. Cell height, radius and the filled colour are classes in the same file.
weight: light: Eleven plain cells over native radios with a short colour and border fade.
